description: Assess an individual's eligibility for British Columbia government-funded career training programs, including WorkBC Skills Training (up to 100% tuition + living supports), StudentAid BC non-repayable grants & 0% loans, StrongerBC Future Skills Grant (up to $3,500), and SkilledTradesBC apprenticeship grants. Use this tool when a user asks whether they qualify for free or subsidized career training in BC. Returns matched funding programs, eligibility notes, and official guide URLs.

career_field.description: Optional target career or industry (e.g., 'healthcare', 'HCA', 'ECE', 'IT', 'trades', 'electrician', 'trucking'). Used to surface sector-specific grants such as SkilledTradesBC.

employment_status.description: Current employment situation in British Columbia: 'unemployed' (out of work / EI-eligible), 'underemployed' (part-time or low-wage seeking upskilling), 'employed' (working full-time), or 'newcomer' (recent immigrant/refugee).

residency.description: Canadian immigration or residency status: 'citizen' (Canadian citizen), 'pr' (Permanent Resident / Protected Person), 'work_permit' (temporary work permit holder), or 'international_student'.

name: check_bc_funding_eligibility
title: Check BC Training Funding Eligibility
